entities.summary: The Hadžijska Mosque, also called the Vekil-Harrach Mosque or the Vekil-Harrach Hadžijska Mosque, is a mosque in the city of Sarajevo, Bosnia and Herzegovina. It is located in Alifakovac, a neighbourhood in Babića Bašća local community, one of the oldest urban settlements in Centar, Sarajevo.
